description: Lets the locally-served dsh GUI report two things to the host: its light/dark theme, so the self-drawn title bar can follow it (dsh-theme), and that it loaded something other than the GUI, so the shell can show a real error instead of leaving dsh's raw 401 text as the whole window (dsh-gui-fault). Deliberately emit-only: the dsh page renders model output, so it must not inherit the `default` capability's core:default grant (window control, path, app APIs). Scoped to the `dsh-gui` webview, the only one ever navigated to the backend origin. Capabilities without a `remote` block do not apply to remote origins, so this is the whole surface the backend origin gets — Tauri also rejects app-defined commands from a remote origin unless a capability names them, and none does.
